verdict.rationale: Folk documents batch API endpoints that act on up to 100 records per request (folk-docs-6) and bulk enrichment of up to 500 people (folk-docs-12). Its official MCP server also has documented use cases for updating many records at once and importing contact lists (folk-docs-19, folk-docs-21), which gives AI-native users a bulk path through the API and through MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations, and documentation of exactly which resources and operations (create/update/delete) the batch endpoints cover beyond the 100-record cap.
